'''Petrify''' (or '''Petrified''') is a [[debuff]]. Similarly to being [[frozen]], [[petrified]] modifies the player's [[action speed]] by reducing it by 100%. Effects that prevent or minimize lowering of [[action speed]], like Trickster's {{psl|One Step Ahead}}, [[Juggernaut]]'s {{psl|Unstoppable}}, {{il|Kaom's Roots}}, {{il|The Balance of Terror}}, or some [[Scourge modifier]]s, will prevent the player from being stuck in place and unable to use any skills. Petrified can only be removed by waiting out its debuff duration.

Petrified is most commonly inflicted through Petrification Statues, a totem-like object depicting a gorgon (a humanoid with snakes as hair). Petrification Statues will inflict a stacking debuff on enemies looking toward it that reduces action speed by 15% per stack. At 6 stacks, the target becomes Petrified. These stacks can be removed by physically turning around away from the statue.

==Sources==
===Skills===
* {{sl|id=SummonPetrificationStatue}} from {{il|Gorgon's Gaze}}
* [[Blight tower|Stone Gaze Tower]] in [[Blight (game mechanic)|Blight encounters]] can petrify Blighted monsters.

==Monsters==
* [[The Basilisk]] in [[The Boiling Lake]] and [[The Gorgon]] in {{il|Sulphur Vents Map}} can petrify a character if the character is looking at it for several seconds while it is channelling its "Stone Gaze" skill, a variation of the skill used by a Petrification Statue.
* Petrification Statues are invulnerable environmental hazards that apply Petrified. They are found in several sources:
** The boss arena in {{il|Pillars of Arun}} contain several Petrification Statues.
** The [[tier 17 map]] mod {{ml|MapUberModPetrify}} spawns Petrification Statues while encountering enemies.
** [[Humid Fissure]] nodes in the [[Azurite Mine]] contains a destroyable Petrification Statue as part of its encounter.
** The modifier "Harimal's Wall" ({{sl|id=BetrayalUpgradeModPetrificationStatue}}) found on [[Immortal Syndicate]] members can summon Petrification Statues.
** The [[Major Affliction]] "Chiselled Stone" in [[the Forbidden Sanctum]] can cause enemies to Petrify on hit. This effect can apply consecutively and can cause the player to be permanently petrified if hit often enough.
